name: GoPDFTools Form Leads Dashboard
author: smfedeveloper

sections.description:
GoPDFTools Form Leads Dashboard helps you manage website form submissions like a simple CRM directly inside WordPress.

Instead of searching emails for leads, you can view, organize, and track all submissions in one structured dashboard.

The plugin automatically detects form fields and stores all submitted data, so it works with different form structures without requiring manual configuration.

Supported form plugins:

• WPForms
• Contact Form 7
• Elementor Forms (Pro)

Perfect for freelancers, agencies, and businesses who want an easy way to manage leads inside WordPress.

Features

Automatic Field Detection

Captures all submitted form fields automatically including:

• name
• email
• phone
• message
• company
• budget
• dropdown selections
• checkboxes
• custom fields

No manual field mapping required.

CRM Style Dashboard

View all leads in a structured admin interface.

Quick stats overview:

• total leads
• new leads
• converted leads
• monthly leads

Lead Status Tracking

Organize leads using statuses:

• New
• Contacted
• Qualified
• Proposal Sent
• Converted
• Lost

Lead Detail View

Each lead shows all captured form fields dynamically.

Notes System

Add internal notes to track follow ups and communication.

Source Tracking

See which page generated each lead.

Search Leads

Search leads by name, email, or submitted field values.

Lightweight

Uses a custom database table and runs only during form submission.

Supported Form Plugins

WPForms

Contact Form 7

Elementor Forms (Pro version required)

More integrations planned in future updates.

Links

GoPDFTools:
https://gopdftools.io
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate the plugin from WordPress admin
  3. Go to Smart Leads in the admin menu
  4. Submit a form using WPForms, Contact Form 7, or Elementor Forms
  5. Leads will automatically appear in the dashboard

No configuration required.
sections.faq:
Does the plugin detect form fields automatically?

Yes. The plugin automatically captures all submitted form fields without requiring setup.

Different forms can contain different fields and all values will still be stored and displayed.

Does this work with Elementor free?

Elementor Free does not include a form widget.

You can use WPForms or Contact Form 7 with Elementor Free.

Can I export leads?

Yes. Leads can be exported as CSV.

Will this slow down my website?

No. The plugin uses a lightweight custom database table and only runs when forms are submitted.

Is this a full CRM?

This plugin provides a simple CRM style lead management dashboard inside WordPress.
